name: Vanilla Cookbook
short_desc: Self-hosted recipe manager with smart ingredient parsing, unit conversion, recipe scaling, and URL scraping.
description: A self-hosted recipe manager designed to keep things simple. Smart ingredient display with automatic unit conversion (US volumetric to metric/imperial), recipe scaling, nutrition parsing, and recipe scraping from hundreds of sites via URL or bookmarklet. Features include multi-level tagging, shopping list, cooking logs with calendar view, sharing, PWA support, user management with optional OAuth/OIDC, and optional LLM-powered features (recipe generation, translation, semantic search, image analysis). Single container with SQLite — no external database needed.
author: jt196
